verdict.rationale: Lovable's core interface is chat-based natural-language prompting that generates full-stack apps, adds features (auth, database schema) purely from described intent, and executes autonomously in Build/Agent mode with mid-task steering via follow-up messages — all core natural-language operation. Community evidence corroborates real-world use via prompting for prototyping/dashboards, though with quality caveats unrelated to the NL-command axis itself. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of command comprehension breadth/limits and no first-party demo showing complex multi-turn NL command chains beyond docs' examples.
